items.title: AWS announces AWS Interconnect - last mile preview with Equinix
items.blurb: AWS Interconnect - last mile is now available in preview with Equinix. You can connect your infrastructure across Equinix's global network of 282 data centers worldwide to AWS in a few clicks.

items.title: New features for Amazon EC2 Capacity Manager
items.blurb: Amazon EC2 Capacity Manager now offers real-time supportability checks and capacity fulfillment metrics.

items.title: Amazon ECS Gateway Arrives with Generated Hostnames and No Custom Domain Support
items.blurb: AWS has released Amazon ECS Gateway, an account-level ingress resource letting platform teams define networking once and application teams opt services in with a connector.

items.title: Amazon RDS for Oracle now supports copying option groups during cross-Region snapshot copy
items.blurb: Amazon RDS for Oracle now lets you copy the option group associated with a DB snapshot when you copy that snapshot to another AWS Region.

items.title: Amazon WorkSpaces for AI agents now supports Linux and Windows 11 cloud desktops
items.blurb: WorkSpaces for AI agents now supports Linux and Windows 11 cloud desktops, in addition to Windows Server. You can run each AI agent on the operating system that its workflows and applications require.

items.title: Amazon Connect Customer lets agents pause and resume emails
items.blurb: Amazon Connect Customer lets agents pause emails while waiting for information or approvals, freeing them to handle higher-priority contacts and resume their work later.

items.title: Amazon Connect Customer prefills the email address for new threads started from cases
items.blurb: Amazon Connect Customer automatically fills in the customer’s email address from the linked customer profile when agents start a new email thread from a case.
